description: 编辑文学风格。温暖奶油色背景配深色文字，经典优雅。适合法律文书、编辑出版、学术文章展示。
promptSnippet: Literary-editorial style. Warm off-white paper (#FAF9F7) with true-black ink (#1A1A1A), mid-grey (#555555) for secondary text and a restrained crimson (#C41E3A) used at most once or twice per deck. Serif throughout, wide margins, long line lengths. Built for reading, not scanning.
